name: third-party.plandb
description: Curated provider manifest for the plan.ledger capability.

install.method: Use the repository-local PlanDB tooling already configured for the project.
uninstall: Remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set; keep fallback ledger files in the project.

filesystem: Project docs/plan-ledger, docs/adrs and docs/specs fallback files
permissions.approval: Human approval required before writing durable project planning state.

transport.notes: Local project ledger access; no network transport required by this wrapper.

security.notes: Provider manifest only. Does not own PlanDB upstream code. Durable ledger writes require human-visible intent.

risk.notes: Can persist planning and decision state, but remains project-local by default.
